enforced_by: the copywriter and the video teardown read it; nothing refuses an unknown value
note: One list per dial — humour, delivery style, register, pacing, reference world, avoid; the asset is the dial.

rows.name: staccato-urgent
rows.what: Short lines, hard stops, stacking. The rhythm itself says hurry.

extra.when: The opening seconds and the close; anywhere the cost of waiting is the argument.

rows.name: plain-flat
rows.what: Ordinary sentence length, no lift, no adjective doing work the fact should do.

extra.when: Where the claim has to carry itself — the mechanism, the proof, the product.

rows.name: warm-unhurried
rows.what: Longer sentences, soft landings, room left standing after each thought.

extra.when: Identification and transformation beats, where the viewer has to feel unhurried to feel seen.

rows.name: clinical
rows.what: Precise, quantified, no colour. It sounds like a measurement, because it is one.

extra.when: Proof and mechanism beats in a market that has stopped believing adjectives.

rows.name: playful
rows.what: Light, quick, the speaker plainly enjoying themselves.

extra.when: Hooks and identification beats in rooms that enjoy their own subject.

rows.name: intimate-low
rows.what: Quiet, close, said as though to one person who is already listening.

extra.when: The admission, the objection answered honestly, the moment the piece stops addressing a market.
